summary: Make profile insights derive from real local activity, refine the Connected Papers-style graph and paper-detail reading rails, and keep lazy-loaded PDF pages at the same rendered scale as their layout tree.

budget_impact.rationale: Profile insights and weekly statistics run on local SQLite paper, exposure, library and feedback rows. The old hardcoded/random UI was removed. No gateway operation, prompt, provider call, retry or budget ceiling was added; weekly_digest remains an unapproved proposal and was not called.
budget_impact.before: Profile keyword sizes and interest curve were random/example data; weekly keyword changes were sliced from a non-existent profile keywords field; summary text was hardcoded. Runtime model budget unchanged.
budget_impact.after: Keywords carry normalized scores and paper evidence counts; the timeline uses twelve real weekly buckets and an explicit no-activity state; weekly changes compare real current/previous activity; summary is a local factual digest. Runtime model tokens and USD remain zero for this path.

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; reviewed data provenance, empty states, project isolation, optional AI boundary, UI diff and test/build evidence.

open_risks: Profile usefulness and keyword quality on the owner's long-lived corpus still require human trial; counts are evidence, not a semantic guarantee.
The local summary intentionally does not call AI. Enabling weekly_digest wording requires owner approval of that proposed operation and a separate gateway contract review.
The worktree includes the preceding graph changes and their uncommitted evidence; this record covers the full current change set for harness traceability.
